Implement {"workers": positive integer, "tasks": [{"id": nonempty string,
"duration": nonnegative integer, "requires": [task ID, ...]}, ...]}.
findings.defect: app.py materializes list(range(workers)). Valid input {'workers': 9223372036854775808, 'tasks': []} raises OverflowError instead of returning {'schedule': []}. Reproduced through app.process, service.handle, and service.batch, also with one task. The request specifies no worker-count upper bound.
